    Recent findings suggest that A lot of us commiserate about commuting into the office, but there are a few positives to seeing your coworkers regularly, like finding your fellow movie buffs to discuss the latest films with, or bonding with the colleagues you grab drinks with after work. Another upside? Your group may do white elephant gift exchanges, Secret Santa, or at the very least, have an office holiday party. If you are doing a present swap this season, finding creative, affordable gifts for your coworkers could be tricky.

    First, there’s determining the budget; then it’s figuring out whether to get them something practical, fun, edible, or just plain silly. Our thoughtful recommendation is to get a gift they can use immediately or leave at work, like a cute tissue box cover, hand warmers (because the office is always cold), or even a small diffuser that makes the air around them smell better. We found 35 such items they’ll love, and if they truly want to, they could bring and use them at home too.

    According to recent reports, anthropologie has the most adorable mouse pads for the coworker who loves color and whimsy. This one is perfect for book lovers, but we also love the olive and sardines mouse pads.

    The office’s coffee and tea options are typically average, so make their mornings feel more premium with these fancy tea bags. “I got these at work one year, and I ended up falling in love with the tea brand,” Senior Commerce Editor Marina Liao claims. “Not only are the tea bags so cute (I feel bad throwing them out when I’m done), but the steeped tea is also highly aromatic and has depth—much better than the standard bags in the office.”.

    The best gifts for coworkers are the ones they didn’t know they needed until they actually have the item in their hands—and can’t ever part with it. “Rechargeable hand warmers are a sleeper hit when I give them as gifts around the holidays,” claims Managing Editor Sarah Esgro. “People always come back and thank me again because they didn’t realize how much they needed them. They’re sleek, can be easily tucked into a pocket, and don’t burn your hands the way that the disposable ones can. I even gave them to a coworker whose hands were chronically cold in the office, and she used them all year long!”.

    In a recent development, make your manager laugh with this cheeky glass cup, complete with a wooden lid and a reusable straw. It's perfect for iced coffees, matcha lattes, and more.

    Sources indicate that every group has a crafty team member, which makes this LEGO set a good gift to give. They can build it at work during their lunch break and display it on their desk. Best of all, they don’t have to worry about their florals or greenery dying when they come back from the holiday break.

    The portable lunch box options for adults aren’t nearly as cute as the ones for kids, so we went on the hunt for a nice one and found this pick from Kate Spade Fresh York. It packs just the right amount of style while still feeling functional, so if your coworker always brings their lunch from home, give them a lunch box they won’t cringe at.

    Professional chefs formulated this genius hand scrub. It neutralizes any lingering odors on your hands after a long day of cooking. “I snagged a bottle for a friend of mine who loves to cook, and kept a bottle for myself," Associate Shopping Editor Janae McKenzie claims. "It’s basically replaced my typical hand soap; it feels so luxurious, and makes my hands smell and feel amazing, no matter how much garlic I chopped that day.”.

    A blanket is a safe gift for anyone, and if your office tends to run super cold, like ours, a little fluffiness in their cubicle will be very welcome. This furry blanket from Madison Park adds some elegance and softness, making them feel a bit more comfortable at their desk.

    In a recent development, for the days when work gets stressful, this easy-to-use Buddha Board is the perfect at-desk escape. With a refillable water brush, they can paint any design they choose on a canvas that evaporates in minutes. No muss, no fuss, just endless creativity to reset their brain.

    We can't get enough of these cheeky cocktail napkins with the ingredients for a perfect Caesar salad. The coworker who's always shaking up a salad bowl around lunchtime will get a kick out of this.

    Recent findings suggest that the personality hire is a key role in any office dynamic. Say thank you to the person who keeps things fun with this chic game box, complete with playing cards, dice, and a classy velvet lining.

    Putting together the staff holiday party is no easy task. Thank the coworker responsible for this finishing touch for the office Christmas tree: a set of scented tree stems. They complete the festive atmosphere by bringing the scent of fir and spruce to the office.

    This calming bonsai plant does well in low-light, so it's great for office environments. Brighten up their desk and give them something to look forward to when they come in each morning. You can even name it for an extra personal touch.

    We all have one coworker who can't go a day without a Diet Coke. Help them bring that energy home with this cute candle that smells just like their favorite drink. It has a cola scent they'll love when they reach for their fizzy pick-me-up.

    If your coworker travels for work a lot, gift them this flight essential that McKenzie swears by. “I never go to bed or travel without this thing anymore," McKenzie says. "I struggle with insomnia, and it gets worse when I’m not in my own bed. This is what gets me to fall asleep ASAP. The gentle weight on my eyes lulls me to sleep, and it’s a godsend on planes when I need to block out any stimuli.”.

    Sources indicate that okay, how cute is this suitcase-shaped AirPods case cover? It's designed to look like an old-school metal carry-on complete with luggage labels from London and other stylish countries. It's definitely more economical than buying them an actual suitcase.

    Though there's no harm in buying pre-ground beans, any coffee-based drink will taste much more flavorful with freshly ground beans. So, if you sit near an admitted coffee snob, feel free to gift them this, which is small enough to grind one cup's worth of beans at a time.

    Recent findings suggest that it's hard to forget the day's tasks when they're jotted down on brightly colored notecards with funny headlines. This comes in a set of 12, so it's bound to last through the year.

    It has been revealed that during the busy workday, it can be tough to remember to hydrate, which, of course, can lead to headaches, lack of energy, and a whole slew of annoying problems that only slow you down. So, if you want to help your coworkers (and perhaps yourself as well) to keep drinking, get them this water bottle, which is conveniently marked with hourly reminders.

    It has been revealed that if there's a home chef in the office, they need this portable Crock-Pot. Now, they can bring their homemade soups, chili, or even queso nice and hot until they're ready for lunchtime.
